subject: Request: Strategic onboarding discount for CobaltCare — VP/CFO signoff
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: CobaltCare onboarding discount request — early-stage pilot

Markus / Marissa —

Quick summary: CobaltCare (healthtech) is asking for a 45% onboarding discount on their first 12-month pilot. They want a 6-week go-live with a 3-month lock on pricing thereafter. The ARR on the pilot would be $120k at list; with the discount asked we’d be at ~$66k first-year.

Why this is in play:
- They’re a referenceable payer integration prospect in the West region; the product fit is strong and they’ve signaled potential expansion to enterprise after pilot (case studies + integration).
- Competitive pressure: two competitors offered a free first-month + below-list rates for pilots.

Attached: proposed rate card (vanessa sent initial draft).

Ask: Need guidance on whether we can approve a 45% onboarding concession (one-time) or whether this requires VP/CFO signoff and minimum commitment terms.

Next steps I recommend:
1) If signoff needed, route to Marissa with a short memo and recommended guardrails (min monthly usage floors, 12-month commit, outcome milestones).
2) Offer a scaled ramp: 30% onboarding discount + performance milestone credit at 3 months if adoption targets met.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: CobaltCare_Proposed_RateCard_V2.pdf]
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: RE: CobaltCare onboarding discount request — early-stage pilot

Marissa —

Looping you in to request an exception memo for a one-off onboarding concession. Vanessa has outlined the business case above. Key signals: referenceability, likely expansion to multi-region in year 2, and strong integration partner endorsement (CloudBridge Network).

My recommendation: approve a one-time onboarding concession but limit exposure:
- Offer 30% onboarding discount applied as a credit across first 3 months (not compounded on per-token usage).
- Require a 12-month minimum commitment with a guaranteed $75k first-year minimum.
- Include a clawback: if they cancel before month 9, a prorated repayment of the onboarding credit.

I drafted a short exception memo for internal approvals and attached a redlined SOW with the proposed terms. Please see the modeling on page 2.

If you think CFO signoff is required, please advise and I’ll escalate formally.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of West Accounts — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: CobaltCare_Redelined_SOW.docx]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T09:30:00-08:00
Subject: RE: CobaltCare onboarding discount request — early-stage pilot

Thanks for the memo — I reviewed the draft SOW and the proposed rate card. A few clarifying questions before I decide on signoff:

1) Revenue protection: can you confirm the blended unit economics (tokens / embedding units) under the 30% concession and projected monthly spend profile? I want to see NPV impact vs list.
2) Reference value: who is the internal sponsor at CobaltCare committing to the case study? Can we get a named success metric (e.g., 3 integrations completed + 1 public case study) tied to the milestone credit?
3) Term & enforcement: ensure the contract has the repayment/clawback language and clear cancellation penalties. Legal redline looks ok but make the clawback explicit (prorated based on months remaining).

If the answers are as above, I’m prepared to sign off on a conditional approval:
- Approve 30% onboarding concession (applied as credits across first 3 months).
- Require the $75k first-year minimum and a 12-month term.
- Tie an additional 10% performance credit (applied in month 4) contingent on agreed uptake metrics and a public reference.

Please send me the completed NPV table and the customer commitment language; I’ll finalize the approval and loop in finance for booking treatment.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | VP, Finance (Interim CFO) — Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T15:10:00-08:00
Subject: RE: CobaltCare onboarding discount request — early-stage pilot

Marissa —

Attached is the NPV sketch and the updated SOW with explicit clawback language and the milestone metrics. Summary of the financials (conservative ramp):
- List ARR (pilot): $120,000
- Proposed 30% onboarding credit applied as $12.5k/mo credit for months 1–3 (total $37.5k)
- Guaranteed first-year minimum: $75,000
- If adoption milestone met by month 3 (3 integrations + published case study), apply additional 10% credit in month 4 (approx $12k).
- Net expected first-year revenue (if milestone achieved): ~$84.5k

Clawback language: "If customer terminates prior to the completion of month 9, customer will repay a pro-rated portion of onboarding credits equal to (9 - months_completed)/9 of the total credits applied." Legal reviewed and approved the proposed phrasing.

I’ve also secured a named sponsor: Maya Shah (Head of Product, CobaltCare) has agreed to a public case study and will be the signatory on the SOW.

Attaching the revised files for final signoff.

Markus
[Attachments: CobaltCare_Redelined_SOW.docx, CobaltCare_Proposed_RateCard_V2.pdf]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-24T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Approval: CobaltCare onboarding concession (conditional)

Approved on a conditional basis — executive signoff follows these conditions which must be added to the SOW and acceptance checklist:
1) 30% onboarding credit applied as specified, capped at $37.5k.
2) $75k minimum first-year commitment.
3) Clawback clause as written (prorated repayment if termination before month 9).
4) Performance credit of 10% contingent on: 3 integrations completed + published case study by month 4; credit applied in month 4 only upon verification.
5) Customer must sign the redlined SOW with named sponsor and provide purchase order or equivalent finance approval prior to contract execution.

Finance (Karthik) — please prepare booking guidance (how to recognize credits vs. cash, and revenue deferral if necessary). Legal to attach final SOW to the DocuSign envelope and route to Maya Shah (maya@cobaltcare.io).

Markus / Vanessa — once DocuSign link is ready, please send to customer and copy Marissa/Karthik.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | VP, Finance (Interim CFO) — Redwood Inference
